text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
When we conducted the physical fitness 
test in PE class today, my records 
improved by an average of 1.3 times 
compared to last year.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Her shuttle run in particular improved by 
1.5 times compared to last year, showing 
significant growth.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it has been mathematically 
proven that Master's training was highly 
significant.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, to express my gratitude to 
Master, I present this "trifle" as a gift.

With those words, I was handed the 
"Special Select Carrot Juice," rumored to 
be quite popular among the students.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have input traditional "etiquette" for 
expressing gratitude and prepared this. 
"It is not much, but..."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I look forward to working with 
you going forward. Master.

"Regardless of that 'trifle', it seems 
your coaching is going splendidly!"
